created_for: Phase 2 preregistration; not a pilot result

selection_rule.description: Deterministic hand-curated contrastive sample selected before Phase 2 execution from existing LCATS feasibility and metadata-selection artifacts. Entries are ordered by stratum, then by sample_id. Provisional strata are sampling targets only; human annotation creates the gold labels.
selection_rule.story_path_semantics: sample story_path values are repository-relative paths from the LCATS repository root
